title: Masala Egg Scramble (Bhurji)
instructions: Finely chop the onion, tomato, and green chili.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté onions until translucent.
Add tomatoes and green chili; cook for 2 minutes until soft.
Whisk eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pour into the skillet.
Scramble gently on low heat until cooked through.

title: Garlic Butter Fried Rice
instructions: Mince the garlic cloves finely.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat and sauté garlic for 1–2 minutes until golden brown.
Add cooked rice, breaking up any clumps.
Drizzle soy sauce and sprinkle pepper. Toss continuously on high heat for 3 minutes.

title: Classic Paneer / Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: Cube the paneer, onion, and bell pepper into equal bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a skillet and lightly sear paneer cubes for 2 minutes until light brown.
Stir-fry onions and bell peppers on high heat for 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return paneer to the pan, toss with soy sauce, and serve hot.

title: Creamy Peanut Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles in water according to packet instructions and drain.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, chili flakes, and 2 tbsp hot water until smooth.
Toss the hot drained noodles into the peanut sauce until well coated.

title: Microwave Mug Omelette
instructions: Coat a microwave-safe mug lightly with butter or cooking spray.
Crack eggs into the mug, add milk, salt, pepper, and whisk thoroughly.
Fold in chopped spinach and shredded cheese.
Microwave on HIGH for 60–90 seconds until fluffed and cooked.
